One convention

Plain code: adamic_code(self, arguments). Counted code: adamic_counted_code(self, arguments, argument_count).
Plain methods: adamic_method(self, arguments). Counted methods: adamic_counted_method(self, arguments, argument_count).
Each shape has exactly one typedef. No call uses a function-pointer cast. Typed union dispatch selects the shape of the actual closure or method.
Count observations include arguments.length, rest binding, and incompatible optional absence representations in the closed-world function-type candidate set. Compatible omitted slots are padded by the caller.
Receiver packing and canonical frame support have independent feature flags. Neither creates a counted convention by itself. Receiver packing copies the packed layout, not the observable argument count, so rest slots survive prefixing this.
Canonical counted constructors use the same argument order as ordinary closures; cache comparisons select the active typed pointer member.

Hunk decisions and witnesses

Checked union narrowing is retained instead of incoming unchecked ir.Narrow. Array predicate narrowing retains the declared element contract and checks the runtime array brand.
Witnesses: e4eec87_f2_union_narrow_call.a, e4eec87_f2b_union_narrow_number.a, host_array_predicate.a, host_array_unknown_predicate.a. All passed the Node oracle in both backends.
Break.Depth retains scope and finally cleanup. Break.Label and Continue.Label use their named target and perform the corresponding cleanup.
Witnesses: taste_labels.a and stage3/fixtures/taste/23_labels_finally.a. Both passed the Node oracle.
Nested preallocation does not replace definite-assignment declarations. Non-null assertions unwrap synthetic checked union loads before performing their own nullish check.
Witnesses: non_null.a, non_null_definite.a, non_null_initialized.a; the latter two passed after restoring field readiness on writes.
Imported const labels retain front-3's proof. Host effectful case expressions remain accepted and short-circuited. Literal-only cases retain main's original emission.
Witnesses: imported_const_cases/*, switch_case_declarations/*, taste_stage3_representations.a, and the switch mutants.
New joining witnesses: closure_convention_nested.a and closure_convention_receiver_rest.a; Node agreement, sanitizers, release and leak checks passed.
Hunk-by-hunk resolution audit: /tmp/closure-convention-front-hunk-decisions.json.

Runtime audit

Searches: rg -n -e '->code\s*\(' -e '\.code\s*\(' -e 'counted_code\s*\(' internal/native/runtime, and rg -n adamic_method internal/native/runtime.
Live tree: array.c's sort comparator calls adamic_closure_call(compare, {left,right}, 2). The helper calls adamic_code with two arguments or adamic_counted_code with three. No cast.
adamic.h:137 and :141 are the counted/plain closure invocations; :290 and :291 are the counted/plain method invocations. One typedef per shape.
object.c:67 and :93 retrieve adamic_method_entry; they do not invoke a code pointer. union.c:135 inspects a method table; class_inheritance.c inspects function-index virtual tables.
map_set.c: collection_next ignores presence, so its definition and constructor use adamic_code(self, arguments), with no count.
The external library snapshot 132d9919 additionally contains node_process.c:436/:441, parallel.c:197/:300, regexp_replace.c:114. They are not in this merge; the prior checkpoint lists each original two-argument site. Their integration is not claimed here.

Retains

CLI counted release builds: weak_parent allocations/frees 86/86, retains/releases 253/302, peak 41; typeof_dispatch 9/9, 6/16, peak 3. Both match main.
The previous +2/+2 and +1/+1 were owned Weak/Union values created by fitting fixed call arguments before ownership planning. Fixed fitting remains at the native boundary; only rest-tail elements are fitted in lowering. Counts are numbers and do not retain.
Counts were re-recorded with TestCountsAreRecorded, excluding only stage3/fixtures/taste/21_truthy_loops.a. Its incoming row is preserved, not asserted remeasured.
The complete counts attempt failed because that source casts to a recursive object-field checked view, which interface_cast.go refuses. The source and its expected-success fixture remain intact; the test was not weakened.
